fields.meta_title: Budget Request Form Builder for Departments | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a budget request form that shows each line next to the current budget and keeps the approved amount on every line. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a Budget Request Form That Carries Every Line to a Decision
fields.hero_description: Create a budget request form that itemizes each ask, routes it for review, and saves every request to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What the Form Asks Before Anyone Says Yes
fields.features_subheading: Reviewers get each amount with its reason and backup in one request. Each decision is saved against the line it applies to.
fields.feature_1:
Line items with a running total

Requesters add one line per cost, each with an amount and a sentence on what it pays for. The total updates as they type, and a line with no amount or no purpose cannot be sent.
fields.feature_2:
Questions that fit the kind of cost

An equipment line asks for the vendor and a quote. An event line asks for the date and expected attendance, and a staff line asks for the hours and the rate behind its total.
fields.feature_3:
Review steps you set in a sentence

Write the route in your prompt: the department head first, then finance, and a third step above an amount you pick. Emergent builds that logic, and you change it by prompting.
fields.feature_4:
Alerts when a request moves

The app emails the requester or posts in Slack when a request is approved or comes back with a question. Reviewers get a reminder when a request waits on them past your date.
fields.feature_5:
Every request in a database you own

Requests save as rows in a database you own, with no response caps in budget season. Filter by department or fiscal year to compare what each team asked for and was granted.
fields.feature_6:
The code is yours to keep

On paid plans, export the full code of your budget request app to your GitHub repository. Host it where you choose and connect it to the accounting tools you already use.

fields.usecase_heading: Four Requests on Their Way to a Decision
fields.tab_content_1:
With this year beside it, camp's $1,400 rise stands out

Fernbank Street Church builds its budget from one request per ministry. Youth director Ilka Haldane asked for $9,600, against $8,200 this year. Her form put this year's figure beside each line. The committee saw the whole rise on summer camp, $4,800 against $3,400, and her reason: a second bus.
fields.tab_content_2:
Its quote attached, the $560 bus line moves on

The Wyecliff College Astronomy Club wants $740 from the student senate for a dark-sky trip. The senate wants a vendor quote on any line over $200, and the $560 charter bus line would not send until the club uploaded one. The $180 snack line needed none. Treasurer Ozias Tesfaye slotted it for October 9.
fields.tab_content_3:
All four lines answered, two cut to reach $12,500

Corrigan Hill Library's children's room asked the board for $18,000 across four lines, and the board approved $12,500. Librarian Rhiannon Fairlie found an approved amount on every line. Prizes and books came through in full, while performers got $3,500 of $6,000 and tablets $1,000 of $4,000, each with a note.
fields.tab_content_4:
When three departments run late, each head gets a reminder

Matthias Rydberg runs the budget cycle at Sallowmere Gauge Works, where 14 department heads send requests by September 30. On September 24 his tracker showed 11 in and 3 missing. The app emailed each missing head a reminder with a link to their draft, and Osric Nwankwo in Facilities opened his that afternoon.

fields.howto_title: How to Make a Budget Request Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to set up a budget request form that asks for the right detail and records what each line gets.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 List the lines your budget already uses
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Decide what each line must explain
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Set the backup a large line needs
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Map who reviews and in what order
fields.howto_step_1_des: Start from the lines in this year's budget, such as travel or equipment. When requests use the same lines, each one can sit beside this year's figure, and reviewers compare like with like instead of matching labels by hand.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Write down what a requester owes you on every line: an amount, the reason for it, and the date the money is needed. Each item becomes a required field on the form, in the order a reviewer reads it.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Pick the amount above which a line needs a vendor quote or an estimate, such as $200 for a student club or $5,000 for a department. Below it, a sentence of purpose is enough. Above it, the upload is required.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Write the review route as a list: who sees a request first, who sees it next, and the amount that adds another step. Name a person or a role for each step, not a shared inbox that nobody owns.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Give reviewers a place to approve each line in full, cut it, or decline it, with a short note. The requester sees what was funded and why, and next year's request can start from the approved numbers.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Open the cycle with a due date
fields.howto_step_6_des: Set the date requests are due and when reminders go out, such as 6 days before. Send the form link to every requester on the same day, and use the tracker to see whose request is still missing.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Describe it to Emergent and test it
fields.howto_step_7_des: Paste your lines and review route into a prompt, and Emergent builds the form and its database. Send a test request with one line over your quote amount, and check that it will not send until a file is attached.

faq_plan.q: What is a budget request form?
faq_plan.ref: What is a budget request form?

prov.original: What is a budget request form?

faq_plan.a: A budget request form is the document a department or team fills in to ask for money for a coming period or a specific need. It lists each cost with an amount and a reason, and the people who set the budget approve, cut, or decline each line.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a budget request form?
faq_plan.a: Describe it to Emergent's AI form builder in plain English: the budget lines you use, what each line must explain, and who reviews a request. Emergent builds the form, its review steps, and a database for the requests, and you change any of it by prompting again. The free tier covers building and publishing.

faq_plan.q: What should a budget request form template include?
faq_plan.a: A budget request form template should include the requester's name and department and the period the money covers. Give each cost its own row with an amount, a reason, and the date it is needed. Add an upload for quotes on large lines and an approved amount per line for the reviewer to fill in.

faq_plan.q: How is a budget request form different from a request to pay a bill?
faq_plan.a: A budget request form asks for money to be set aside before anything is bought. A request to pay a bill comes after the purchase, when an invoice is due, and it goes on a check request form that names the payee and the amount.

faq_plan.q: How do I handle mid-year budget requests on the same form?
faq_plan.a: Add a request type at the top: annual or mid-year. A mid-year request then asks two extra questions: what changed since the budget was set, and whether a current line can cover part of the cost. Both types save to the same list, and reviewers can filter by type.

faq_plan.q: How should a budget request form record a partial approval?
faq_plan.a: Give each line its own approved figure, not one total for the whole request. A line can be funded in full, cut to a lower figure, or declined, each with a short note. In the app Emergent builds, those amounts save in a database you own, next to what was asked.

faq_plan.q: What happens after a budget request form is approved?
faq_plan.a: Its approved amounts become the budget the group spends against for that period. As money goes out, staff log what they spent on an expense report form, and each line's spending can be compared with the amount approved for it.

faq_plan.q: Can a budget request form require a quote before it is sent?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Set an amount, and any line above it stays locked until a quote or estimate is attached. Emergent builds that rule from one sentence in your prompt, and you change the amount later the same way.

faq_plan.q: How do you get every department to send budget request forms on time?
faq_plan.a: Pick a due date that leaves reviewers time before the budget meeting, and open the form to everyone at once. Saved drafts help, since a head can start the request and finish it once the quotes are in. In an app Emergent builds, reminders reach each person still missing by email or Slack.

faq_plan.q: Does a budget request replace the form used to order items?
faq_plan.a: No. A budget request asks for money for a period or a project, and a requisition form asks to buy specific items once that money is set aside. Keep both, and have each requisition name the budget line it draws on.

This page shows a budget request form that carries the request through the budget cycle: each line beside this year's figure, a vendor quote required on large lines, an approved amount recorded per line when only part is funded, and a finance lead who sees which departments have not sent theirs.
